summary: Accepted the sealed repair. The source calls the Yimen rise 二紀之間, an approximate duration that cannot be replaced with the Liang dynasty’s AD 907–923 reign interval; 黃巢大亂之後 is retrospective framing for Liang Zu’s founding, not a Huang Chao activity interval.

sourceEvidence: s0006: 「以夷門一鎮，外嚴烽侯，內辟汙萊，厲以耕桑，薄以租賦，士雖苦戰，民則樂輸，二紀之間，俄成霸業。」
reviewedChanges.reason: 二紀 is an approximate two-decade duration within the narrative. It does not identify the start and end years, so AD 907–923 was an invented substitution of the sixteen-year Liang reign and must not stand as the date geometry for this item.

sourceEvidence: s0005: 「梁祖之開國也，屬黃巢大亂之後。」
reviewedChanges.reason: The grammar locates Liang Zu’s founding after the Huang Chao upheaval. It is retrospective contextual framing, not a statement that Huang Chao personally acted throughout AD 875–884; no Western personal-activity interval is warranted by this chapter.
